title: Backend Manager & Sparse Matrices

tasks.description: BackendManager implementation - create centralized backend management with JS, WASM, GPU support
Auto-selection logic - implement automatic backend selection based on matrix size and operation type
SparseMatrix (CSR format) - implement Compressed Sparse Row matrix storage format
Sparse operations (JS) - implement add, multiply, transpose for sparse matrices
Sparse ↔ Dense conversion - implement toDense() and toSparse() methods
Sparse tests - comprehensive tests for CSR storage, sparse operations, and conversions

successCriteria: BackendManager auto-selects optimal backend based on size
SparseMatrix stores data in CSR format efficiently
Sparse operations maintain sparsity where possible
notes: Sprint 8 completes Phase 2 by adding backend auto-selection and sparse matrix support. The CSR format is efficient for sparse linear algebra operations. BackendManager provides centralized backend management with operation-specific thresholds and fallback support. SparseMatrix implements full CSR format with efficient O(log n) element access, sparse-sparse and sparse-dense arithmetic operations, and lossless conversion to/from DenseMatrix. All 58 new sparse tests pass.
